paper_title: Axion dark matter from topological defects
notes: This is a theoretical and computational paper that uses numerical simulations to estimate axion abundance from topological defects (domain walls and strings). Section IV applies existing observational constraints (SN1987A cooling at F_a > 4×10^9 GeV, neutron EDM, and dark matter abundance) to constrain model parameters in the axion production scenario. The paper does not present a new measured experimental or observational limit on any axion coupling in the canonical (mass, coupling) plane. Figure 7-9 show constraints on theoretical parameters (F_a, Ξ, predicted mass ranges) but not on coupling as a function of mass. The work is a reinterpretation/constraint study, not a new experimental limit.
